landing.features_title: Everything a farmer needs, in one place
landing.features_sub: From real-time mandi prices to AI-grounded advisory, FasalNet replaces guesswork with data at every step of the harvest.
landing.feature_ai_desc: Grounded recommendations that combine GPS location, live weather and ICAR agricultural knowledge — not generic chatbot answers.
landing.feature_market_desc: Live APMC mandi prices with ARIMA-based forecasting so you know whether to sell today or wait.
landing.feature_weather_desc: Open-Meteo powered forecasts translated into concrete harvest and storage timing decisions.
landing.feature_storage_desc: Find and book the nearest cold storage by real distance and live capacity, with one-tap confirmation.
landing.feature_risk_desc: A machine-learning model rates your produce SAFE, RISKY or CRITICAL before you decide where it goes.
landing.feature_lang_desc: Fully usable in English, Hindi and Marathi, and designed to stay fast on low-end phones and 2G networks.
landing.ai_desc: Ask a question and FasalNet's advisor pulls from your real GPS location, the live mandi price database, an Open-Meteo weather forecast, an XGBoost price model and an ICAR agricultural knowledge base — then synthesizes a single, actionable recommendation.
landing.ai_point_1: Real-time XGBoost price forecasting for your crop
landing.ai_point_2: Weather and climate risk factored into every recommendation
landing.ai_point_3: Every answer cites the verified sources it drew from
landing.market_title: Know the mandi before you go to the mandi
landing.market_desc: Track live APMC prices across Maharashtra, compare nearby markets for arbitrage, and see where prices are headed with a walk-forward-tested forecasting pipeline.
landing.market_point_1: Ten forecasting models, ranked and backtested honestly
landing.market_point_2: Nearby-market comparison to catch a better price
landing.market_point_3: No synthetic data — every number traces to a real mandi record
landing.weather_title: Time your harvest around the sky
landing.weather_desc: Live Open-Meteo forecasts are turned into plain-language guidance — when to harvest, when to move produce to storage, and when a spoilage risk is about to spike.
landing.weather_point_1: 7-day forecast tuned to your exact location
landing.weather_point_2: Rain, humidity and heat risk explained in farmer terms
landing.weather_point_3: Feeds directly into the AI advisor's recommendations
landing.map_desc: See every partner cold storage near you on an interactive map, ranked by real distance and live available capacity — then book in one tap.
landing.benefit_1_desc: Spot spoilage risk early and route produce to storage before it's too late.
landing.benefit_2_desc: Forecasted mandi prices help you decide whether to sell now or hold.
landing.benefit_3_desc: Compare real nearby mandi prices directly, in your own language.
landing.testimonial_1_quote: I used to lose a part of every onion harvest to spoilage. Now I check the risk score first and book storage the same day.
landing.testimonial_2_quote: The mandi price forecast helped me hold my soybean stock for two extra weeks and sell at a better rate.
landing.testimonial_3_quote: Managing bookings and capacity used to be all phone calls. Now it's all confirmed on one dashboard.
landing.final_cta_note: Free to join · No hidden fees · Works on 2G
